newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's Vranitzky to visit China.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Vranitzky to visit China.

text.p: Austrian Chancellor Franz Vranitzky will start a three-day visit to China on Tuesday, accompanied by 70 Austrian business leaders seeking new contracts in the rapidly-growing Chinese economy.

Vranitzky, who last travelled to China in 1993, will meet state and Communist Party chief Jiang Zemin as well as Prime Minister Li Peng. The visit marks the 25th anniversary of the start of official diplomatic relations between the two nations.

The chancellor said human rights issues would feature high on the agenda. "These issues will definitely be included in the talks," the Austrian news agency APA quoted him as saying in the southern town of Klagenfurt,
Austria has been a strong critic of China's human rights record.
